name: getTxtProgressBar
title: Current value of a text progress bar

origin.description: Return the current value of a txtProgressBar.
origin.details: The value is the last accepted update. An out-of-range update does not change it.

translation.description: Return the current value of a text progress bar.
translation.details: Another object raises the same class error R uses, including the curly quotes.
translation.example:
from utils import getTxtProgressBar, setTxtProgressBar, txtProgressBar
import io
bar = txtProgressBar(min=0, max=10, style=1, file=io.StringIO())
setTxtProgressBar(bar, 4)
print(getTxtProgressBar(bar))
